title: Unsupervised Tool Evolution for Coding Agents in Data-Lake Analytics
abstract: arXiv:2610.27327v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents can answer analytical questions over a data lake by discovering, cleaning, and joining the relevant data. However, they discard this work after each question and redo it from scratch for the next one. Tool evolution, which automatically builds and refines reusable tools across tasks, is a natural fit for this repetition. Since a ground-truth label for a data-lake question requires an expert to solve it first, we consider the unsupervised setting. We propose TEAL (Tool Evolution for Analytics over data Lakes), which evolves a library of tools and usage skills for a given Worker agent without labels. Two agents propose tools from complementary evidence, an Explorer from the data lake itself and a Critic from Worker trajectories. A proposed change is kept only if the Worker adopts the tool on a rerun without extra steps and any changed answer is supported by trajectory evidence. translated_title: 面向数据湖分析中编码代理的无监督工具演化
translated_abstract: 编码代理可以通过发现、清洗和连接相关数据，来回答关于数据湖的分析问题。然而，它们在回答完每个问题后就丢弃这些工作成果，并在下一个问题中从头重新执行。工具演化，即跨任务自动构建和改进可复用工具的方法，天然适合解决这种重复性工作。由于数据湖问题的真实标签需要专家先解决该问题才能获得，我们考虑无监督的设定。我们提出了TEAL（面向数据湖分析的工具演化），它无需标签即可为给定的Worker代理演化出一个工具库和使用技能库。两个代理从互补的证据来源中提出工具：Explorer（探索者）从数据湖本身获取证据，而Critic（批评者）从Worker的执行轨迹中获取证据。只有当Worker在重新运行时无需额外步骤就能采纳所提议的工具，且任何发生变化的答案都有轨迹证据支持时，该提议的更改才会被保留。我们还引入了TEAL-Q，它可以生成合成的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TEAL框架，通过Explorer和Critic两个互补代理，在无标签的无监督条件下为编码代理自动演化可复用的工具库与使用技能，从而解决数据湖分析中每个问题都要从零开始重复劳动的效率问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes TEAL, an unsupervised label-free framework that evolves a reusable library of tools and usage skills for coding agents through two complementary agents (an Explorer and a Critic), eliminating the redundant from-scratch work in data-lake analytics.
